sources.title: Angola

sources.supportingExcerpt: For holders of national passports and other travel documents: Visa required

sources.title: Grenada
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia

sources.title: Jordan

sources.title: Kuwait
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia

sources.title: Mongolia

sources.title: Electronic Visa Application System

sources.supportingExcerpt: Serbia ... In 3 Steps your evisa is ready!

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Angola visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia MFA's live Angola advisory classifies Serbian national passports as visa required; an online application option does not establish electronic issuance.
conditions: Apply through the Angolan mission or the listed online application channel before travel; the source does not establish that online filing itself issues an eVisa.
Applies to short visitor travel on an ordinary Serbian passport; work, residence and special documents remain outside scope.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Grenada visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Serbia MFA's live Grenada advisory says Serbian passport holders do not require a visa.
conditions: Applies to a Serbian ordinary passport for a short visitor trip. Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Serbia MFA says Serbian national-passport holders need a Jordan visa that can be obtained at a border crossing.
conditions: The ordinary passport must be valid at least six months for tourist travel.
The status records the expressly available border-issuance route; warnings, work, residence, transit and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Kuwait advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia MFA says Serbian citizens require a Kuwait visa and cannot use eVisa or visa-on-arrival routes.
conditions: Obtain the necessary visa before travel; the source expressly excludes eVisa and border-arrival issuance.
The passport must be valid at least one year for tourist travel; work, residence, transit and special documents remain outside scope.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Mongolia electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia MFA confirms a visa is required, while Mongolia's official eVisa service lists Serbia and issues the approved document before travel.
conditions: Apply online, pay the fee and receive the eVisa before travel; carry a copy for border scanning.
The passport must have at least 180 days of validity when applying.
Applies to short visitor travel; transit, study, work, residence, diplomatic and official passport rules remain separate.

application.label: Mongolia eVisa application
steps: Receive the approved eVisa before travel and carry a copy for arrival.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: North Macedonia visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Serbia MFA's live North Macedonia advisory says Serbian citizens need no visa for entry and stays up to 90 days.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Serbian passport for up to 90 days. The separate biometric identity-card route does not broaden this passport classification.
Employment, study, marriage, residence, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Saudi Arabia visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia MFA's live Saudi Arabia advisory classifies Serbian national passports as visa required.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Serbian passports for a short visit. Transit arrangements, work, residence and special-document routes are outside scope.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Sierra Leone visitor visa
policies.summary: Serbia MFA says Serbian citizens may enter Sierra Leone only with the appropriate visa.
conditions: Applies to ordinary Serbian passports for a short visit. The source does not establish a separate electronic or arrival-issued route.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official and special-document routes remain outside scope.

policies.title: Serbian ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Serbia MFA's live Ukraine advisory says Serbian citizens need no visa for stays up to 90 days in 180 days.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Serbian passport for up to 90 days in 180 days; for tourism, the passport must remain valid at least three months after departure.
Health insurance and final border admission remain separate; work, residence, special documents and operational access are outside scope.
